Checkpoint 2: 20-monster sample, before and after

Twenty existing Basic families redrawn with generator v2. Names, types, positions, colours, sizes, personalities and gameplay profiles are unchanged; only the art recipe is proposed, and nothing is wired into the game. Each card shows the silhouette and the shaded sprite at 6× nearest-neighbour, then the shaded sprite at 16, 24, 32 and 48 px on turf. The game draws field sprites at about 23 px on a 390 px phone and about 46 px on a 768 px tablet (crowded-field preview).

Coverage: 12 of 12 types, 10 of 10 positions, 20 structures; 13 small and 7 medium forms (the Basic batch has no large forms). Every proposal passes the generator diagnostics: no unsupported, invisible or oversized choices.
